scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @trail/web build && pnpm --filter @trail/web build:tutor-coach && pnpm --filter @trail/server build && pnpm --filter @trail/vision build && pnpm --filter @trail/webxr build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev:web: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,web,server "pnpm dev:shared" "pnpm --filter @trail/web dev" "pnpm --filter @trail/server dev"
